_comment: NYXUS design tokens — the single source of truth for every brand value across the OS. Edit this file, then run `iso-builder/scripts/nyxus-render-tokens --render` and the renderer rewrites every consumer file (Firefox userChrome, Chromium theme.colors, web artifact :root blocks, Hyprland border colors, dunst frame colors, eww accent SCSS, GTK accent vars, etc.) so they all stay in lock-step. Sprint K-E rev r16 (2026-05-14).

surface_glass_rgba._role: frosted-glass surface (Hyprland Dual-Kawase blur lives behind this)

cream._role: PRIMARY text + foreground — must be cream, never white, never magenta

copper._role: ACCENT — focus rings, active tab pip, secondary, accent, destructive, ok

copper_deep._role: deep copper — Hyprland gradient stop, hover-pressed

ink_void._role: deeper black — frosted-glass surfaces, GTK window_bg, hyprlock inner

cream_inactive._role: Hyprland inactive-border faded cream stop (only used for unfocused window bezels)

pure_black._role: absolute black — Hyprland border end-stop, deepest shadow anchor

border_hairline_hsl._role: 1px hairline border in HSL form (web artifact :root)

hairline_rgba._role: 1px hairline border in CSS rgba form (Firefox / Chromium / glass surfaces)
